changelog: New voice command "select last sentence" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ বাক্য সিলেক্ট করো" in Bengali) and the sentence right before the cursor is selected, so you can copy just that sentence or dictate the correction straight over a whole misheard sentence. It is the sentence-sized twin of v14.5's "select last word". The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 48 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
